He also directed 103 films between 1911 and 1916.  He was born in Rockford, Illinois and died in Hollywood, California.  He, along with Henry "Pathe" Lehrman, became an arch-enemy of Charlie Chaplin, who would take direction from nobody while at Keystone.  'Pops' as he was known, was often cast as father to Mabel Normand.

Crone had worked with director Budd Boetticher, on Boetticher's obsession, a docudrama regarding his friend Carlos Arruza, the famous bullfighter. Crone died shortly after completing the tasks, in June 1966.  Earlier in his career, he had been the original editor on "Citizen Kane", before being replaced by Robert Wise.
